bugs.symptom: Migration 20261019T100000-drive-space-id-notnull fails on boot: column "space_id" of relation "drive_folders" contains null values; DatabaseMigrationService exits the program (backend crash-loop)
bugs.root_cause: Migration B set spaceId NOT NULL while v1 drive rows still had space_id NULL. The backfill was only a documented manual prerequisite, never automated into the migration path, so any database containing v1 drive data rejected the constraint and crash-looped the backend on boot.
bugs.regression_test: drive-space-type.spec.ts › 'B: backfills v1 rows BEFORE any schema alteration' + 'B: sweeps residual NULL share/version rows from their files, then constrains'

findings.evidence: The docx-export endpoint now returns application/zip by default (bundleAttachments defaults to true), changing its deliverable from a single .docx to a .zip containing document.docx + attachments/.
findings.impact: Frontend callers that download/attach the .docx directly may need to handle the .zip (or pass bundleAttachments: false) to keep the previous single-file behavior.
findings.repair: Update the client export/download handler to unpack the .zip, or explicitly set bundleAttachments: false where a single .docx is required.
findings.verifier: Inspect the docx-export client call; integration test the endpoint response content-type/extension.

findings.evidence: docx@9.7.1 has no native file embedding (no EmbeddedFile/OLE); non-image files are carried as a clickable hyperlink to the attachment URL instead of embedded bytes.
findings.impact: Non-image attachments (PDF/docx/zip) are not physically inside the .docx; they require network access to the server to open.
findings.repair: If self-contained non-image embedding is required, add an OLE embedded-object XmlComponent or switch to the HTML/markdown zip export (which already bundles attachments as files).
findings.verifier: Open generated .docx and confirm the PDF link resolves; or use zip export for offline file bundling.

findings.evidence: Jest (CommonJS) cannot load the ESM-only deps the docx path pulls in (docx, image-dimensions, @tiptap/extension-unique-id, @sindresorhus/slugify); the server unit test mocks them, so the real .docx byte generation was not executed end-to-end in the test env.
findings.impact: Regression coverage is at the service-orchestration level, not the actual docx bytes; a runtime/docx-output failure would not be caught by the suite.
findings.repair: Add a runtime smoke test (or e2e against a live server) calling /api/docx-export asserting a valid .docx (PK zip), or add jest transformIgnorePatterns/moduleNameMapper so the ESM libs load.
findings.verifier: curl -XPOST /api/docx-export | file - (expect Microsoft Word); or jest with ESM enabled
